name: amicale-conges
description: SaaS de gestion des congés, maladies et absences — Amicale du Personnel de la Banque Centrale

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix terminal install
scripts.test: node server/tests/test-auth.cjs && node server/tests/test-soldes.cjs && node server/tests/test-pointage.cjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix terminal run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix terminal run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/index.js
